title: Unreal Berries Grape & Lime 10ml Nic salt E-Liquid
description: Grape & Lime from Unreal Berries is heady fruit mix featuring the taste of luscious, juicy sweet Green Grapes and sharp, zesty Limes. The slightly sour citrus edge lifts the juicy flavour of Grapes to giddy new heights, for a flavour that’s endlessly vapable and utterly delicious. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the perfect sweet spot between flavour and cloud production, while the Nicotine Salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter kits and pod devices. They’re best used with high-resistance coils (0.8ohm-1.2ohm) for both RDL (restricted direct-to-lung) and MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping experiences. Nic Salts are perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. Nicotine salts differ from regular freebase e-liquids thanks to their alkaline formulation, allowing for a higher nicotine concentration. Nicotine from Nic Salt e-liquids is absorbed into the bloodstream faster, offering almost instantaneous relief from nicotine cravings. The unique magic of Nic Salts means that you’ll enjoy a super-smooth, comfortable throat hit despite the higher nicotine concentration. Unreal Berries are a range of Nic Salt E-liquids that are made in the UK by Unreal e-liquids, a brand that are famous for their fruit flavours. They’ve paired only the very Berriest flavours with the juiciest fruits in each blend for a deliciously natural tasting berry vape experience.
